description: This file implements a ValidationService class for executing validation runs, generating reports, and managing validation data within a software project that appears to process data submissions and evaluate their conformance, freshness, and completeness. It interacts with a database and manages artifact storage, and references external utility modules and audit services.

classes.name: ValidationService
classes.description: Service for validation run execution, report generation, and retrieval, including schema conformance, freshness, and completeness checks.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] run_validation( self, submission_id: str, validation_profile: str = "baseline", actor_user_id: str = "system", actor_role: str = "system", correlation_id: str = "", )
methods.description: Executes the validation process on a submission, generates a report, uploads artifacts, and updates the database with validation results.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _check_schema_conformance(self, package: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Checks whether the dataset's hash is a placeholder, returning pass or fail accordingly.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _check_freshness(self, package: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Performs a freshness check, currently with static example metrics.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _check_completeness(self, package: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Performs a completeness check, currently with static example metrics.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_validation_report(self, validation_run_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves and loads a validation report artifact associated with a specific validation run.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_validation_runs(self, submission_id: str)
methods.description: Lists all validation runs associated with a submission, ordered by creation time.
